name: digital-marketing-agency-landing-page
description: Professional digital marketing agency landing page with optimized build process

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:html && npm run build:assets
scripts.build:html: npm run validate:html && npx html-minifier-terser --input-dir . --output-dir dist --file-ext html --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --minify-css true --minify-js true
scripts.build:assets: npm run optimize:images && npx copyfiles -u 0 robots.txt sitemap.xml dist/
scripts.clean: npx shx rm -rf dist && npx shx mkdir -p dist/css dist/js dist/images
scripts.test:build: npm run build && npm run preview
scripts.lint: npm run lint:css && npm run lint:js

author: Digital Marketing Agency
